title: Fix LP: #1874719. This is a simple patch commenting out the hardcoded 'node1' node name in the default config file, with that, the hostname will be used as the default node name. FWIW this is the behavior in all supported releases but Focal.
description:
Fix LP: #1874719. This is a simple patch commenting out the hardcoded 'node1' node name in the default config file, with that, the hostname will be used as the default node name. FWIW this is the behavior in all supported releases but Focal.

The package is available here:

https://launchpad.net/~lucaskanashiro/+archive/ubuntu/ha-stack/+packages

autopkgtest is still happy:

autopkgtest [17:39:07]: @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ summary
cfgtool              PASS
quorumtool           PASS
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index f4e324a..75fed53 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+corosync (3.0.3-2ubuntu2.2) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/Make-the-example-config-valid.patch: comment out the node name in
+    config file. With this, we will keep the same behavior as we have in Bionic
+    which is using the output of "uname -n" as the node name (LP: #1874719).
+  * d/t/quorumtool: search for localhost instead of node1
+
+ -- Lucas Kanashiro <kanashiro@ubuntu.com>  Tue, 05 Apr 2022 17:32:25 -0300
+
 corosync (3.0.3-2ubuntu2.1) focal; urgency=medium
 
   * d/p/lp1911904-Don-t-lock-all-current-and-future-memory-if-can-t-in.patch:
